transactions.citation: p37 Property Profile: Appraised Value on Acquisition S$143.8m (Knight Frank Pte Ltd, capitalisation/DCF/direct comparison) and Purchase Price S$140.3m.
transactions.notes: Maiden Singapore Logistics & Industrial acquisition. Purchased from Diamond Land Pte. Ltd. gain_loss_pct DERIVED = (purchase price 140.3m - appraised value 143.8m)/143.8m = -2.43% (i.e., acquired at a 2.43% discount to independent valuation on acquisition). Not disclosed by the AR as a %. Portfolio Statement valuation as at 30 Sep 2025 = S$145.0m (would be +3.35% vs purchase price if used as the reference instead, but the acquisition-date appraisal is the correct same-basis reference).

transactions.counterparty: Three Five Seven Collins Street Pty Ltd (as trustee for Three Five Seven Collins Street Trust)
transactions.citation: p37 Property Profile: Divestment Consideration A$192.1m and Appraised Value on Divestment A$191.0m (Savills Valuations Pty Ltd, capitalisation and DCF methods, as at 1 Jun 2025).
transactions.notes: Exit from Melbourne CBD office, sold A$192.1m vs A$191.0m independent valuation. gain_loss_pct DERIVED = (192.1m-191.0m)/191.0m = +0.58% (sold at a premium to valuation). Letter to Unitholders (p13) narratively describes this as 'approximately 0.6% above valuation' - consistent with but not identical to the derived 0.58%, so kept as derived rather than disclosed since no exact percentage figure is printed. Alt reference_basis=book_value: P&L-recognised gain on divestment S$180,000 (Statement of Total Return, group SGD accounts) vs carrying value S$162,052k (Note 10 investment-property movement, 'Disposal of investment properties (162,052)') = +0.11%; not used as primary because AUD-denominated valuation is the same-currency, deal-level reference matching the sale price. Per-deal net proceeds not separately disclosed (net_sale_proceeds S$160,725,000 is the group-level FY2025 cash-flow figure, single divestment in the year).

transactions.counterparty: Fraser's Property Investments (Europe) B.V., FPI Netherlands B.V. and Stichting Coeval (existing minority shareholders)
transactions.citation: p36: sale of shares to existing minority shareholders of the property-holding companies, consideration EUR23.2m = S$33,414,000 (Note 6955 / Statement of Movements in Unitholders' Funds: 'Divestment of ownership interests to non-controlling interests | (746) | 33,414').
transactions.notes: IFRS-10 equity transaction (sale of shares to existing minority shareholders, no loss of control) - NOT a P&L property divestment, so gain_loss_pct/reference fields are genuinely inapplicable/not disclosed, not merely unfilled. Reduces the Trust's effective interest in each of the 28 German properties to 89.9% (a 3.2%-5.0% reduction per property, so interest_pct is left null as no single deal-level increment is disclosed - the reduction varies by property). No per-deal gain on divestment, no distinct carrying value of the minority interest transferred, and no separate deal-level appraised value are disclosed (confirmed absent per prior extraction worklist; deriving from the (746)/33,414 equity movement is prohibited under invariant against inventing a reference). Portfolio-level German valuations of EUR1,037.8m (First Valuation, Colliers) exist on p36 but are aggregate across all properties, not attributable to this transaction, so not used. sale_consideration (gross) = S$33,414,000; net_sale_proceeds = S$32,994,000.
